superego.definition: n. (psychoanalysis) that part of the unconscious mind that acts as a conscience

superegos.definition:
plural of superego
n. (psychoanalysis) that part of the unconscious mind that acts as a conscience
superegos.translation: (superego 的复数) n. 超自我

supereminence.translation: n. 出类拔萃, 卓越

supereminent.definition:
a. Eminent in a superior degree; surpassing others in
   excellence; as, a supereminent divine; the supereminent glory of
   Christ.
supereminent.translation: a. 卓越的, 极为出色的

supererogate.definition:
v. i. To do more than duty requires; to perform works of
   supererogation; to atone (for a dificiency in another) by means of a
   surplus action or quality.

supererogated.translation: v. 做额外的工作( supererogate的过去式和过去分词 )

supererogating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Supererogate
supererogating.translation: v. 做额外的工作( supererogate的现在分词 )

supererogation.definition: n. an effort above and beyond the call of duty

supererogatory.definition: s more than is needed, desired, or required
supererogatory.translation:
a. 职责以外的, 多余的, 非本质的, 不必要的
[法] 职务以外的, 份外的, 多余的

superette.translation: n. 规模较小的超级商场, 小型自动售货店

superexcellence.translation: n. 卓越, 优秀, 绝佳

superexcellent.definition: a. Excellent in an uncommon degree; very excellent.
superexcellent.translation: a. 卓越的, 优秀的, 绝佳的

superexcitation.translation:
